bug.description: A bulk header consumed the whole 64 MiB allowance while ancestor arrays still required more values. Old scanners waited for an impossible body.
bug.fix: Reserve the minimum bytes for all known following siblings. Static recursion passes their count; incremental scanning keeps one counter. No public API change.
